title: County bus advertising rules in Bill 13
summary: On June 19, Committee Report 26-33 recommended first reading of Bill 13, which updates rules for ads on County buses and bus passes, but the meeting video did not capture the vote on that motion. On May 21 the committee voted 6–0 to replace the bill with a revised version, CD1. After the law changes, the transportation department plans to seek proposals from advertising agencies and may return to change ad rates.
